description: One complete CANOPY VILLAGE principal hall, an actual detailed 144x144 game pixel sprite. A single enormous ancient rough-barked living tree trunk carries the building: two accessible circular timber galleries wrap organically around the trunk at different heights, a broad front ceremonial balcony with a visible carved doorway, rear branches supporting curved green leaf-shingle roofs, a small upper lookout balcony, woven reed wall panels, carved wooden doorframes, thin sturdy balustrades, spiral wooden trunk stairs and two restrained golden lanterns. Thick irregular roots meet the ground. The asymmetric trunk and wrapping galleries dominate the silhouette. This is one hall, with no surrounding houses, no settlement scene, no terrain island, no painted ground or cast shadow. Shallow three-quarter low top-down perspective showing roof and front facade, horizontal front stairs, square-ground-grid game view, consistent upper-left lighting, one-pixel selective dark outlines, deliberate crisp connected pixel clusters, readable timber joinery, restrained material shading, no smooth gradients or antialiasing. Deep forest green, moss and rich chestnut wood with small warm golden lights. Keep all architecture inside the canvas with 6px transparent clearance; the root contact is near bottom centre. Native pixel art only, not a resized illustration or crude geometry. Strong canopy-tree architecture, carefully built floors and entrances, not a cottage in front of a round green tree.
